description.value:
As a full action, the mech can enter or exit its atmospheric entry configuration. While in this form, it cannot move on its own, but it takes no damage from falling or atmospheric entry. The configuration includes small thrusters or wings that allow minor adjustments to keep the mech on track to its landing zone. Recon frames with this component active are invisible. The configuration can be disabled while falling, leaving the mech in the air with no effective momentum from the fall. This is usually not a good idea for mechs without a flight speed.

Auxiliary Slots: 1.
